question: The salaries of X, Y and Z are in the ratio 4:18:21. If the increments of 90%, 90% and 40% are allowed, respectively, in their salaries, then what will be the new ratio of their salaries?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Original ratio = 4 : 18 : 21

Apply multipliers ⇒ 1.9, 1.9, 1.4

New ratio = 4×1.9 : 18×1.9 : 21×1.4

= 7.6 : 34.2 : 29.4 ⇒ multiply by 5

**∴ Answer = 38 : 171 : 147**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio = 4 : 18 : 21

Increments = 90%, 90%, 40%

**Formula used:**

New value = Original × (1 + increase/100)

**Calculation:**

⇒ X = 4 × 1.9 = 7.6

⇒ Y = 18 × 1.9 = 34.2

⇒ Z = 21 × 1.4 = 29.4

⇒ Ratio = 7.6 : 34.2 : 29.4

⇒ Multiply by 5 ⇒ 38 : 171 : 147

**∴ The correct answer is 38 : 171 : 147.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage Increase

New = Old × (1 + rate/100)

Ratio Scaling

Multiply all terms to remove decimals

Simplification

Reduce ratio to simplest integer form
